results.title: How Much Does Vercel Cost? (Updated, October 2026)
results.snippet:
Hobby: $0/month (strictly for personal, non-commercial projects).
 Pro: $20/month per user. This includes baseline allowances for bandwidth, serverless function execution, and image optimization. However, once your app scales beyond these included limits, usage-based overage fees can accumulate rapidly.
 Enterprise: Custom pricing tailored for large organizations requiring advanced security, SSO, and custom SLAs. [...] ### 

Vercel pricing is tiered by plan: the Hobby plan is free forever for personal use; the Pro plan starts at around $20 per user per month with usage credits and extra resource billing on top; and the Enterprise plan has custom pricing tailored to large organizations and usually requires contacting sales for a quote.

### [...] Vercel hosting costs grow mainly with bandwidth, serverless function execution, and team size, not with fixed infrastructure fees.
 Vercel has a free Hobby plan for personal projects and experiments, but it isn’t meant for production or commercial use.
 Most production Next.js applications run on the Pro plan: $20 per user per month, plus usage-based resources like bandwidth and compute.

results.title: Vercel Pricing Plans and Hidden Costs Explained (2026)
results.snippet:
- Vercel offers three pricing plans: Hobby (free) for personal projects, Pro ($20 per user/month) with $20 usage credits, and Enterprise with custom pricing.
- Team seats quickly add up in the Pro plan. Paying $20 per developer every month can become expensive as your team grows.
- Most costs come from usage, and not the base plan. Your final bill depends on how your app runs in production. [...] Source: Vercel.com

Vercel's Pro plan starts at $20 per developer seat per month. This creates a predictable fixed monthly fee based on team seats, with additional resource usage billed separately.

The Pro plan includes all Hobby features in addition to $20 worth of monthly credits and higher infrastructure limits.

Pro also unlocks collaboration features, including shared environments, role-based access control, and free viewer seats for non-developers. [...] Yes, Vercel's Hobby plan is free forever. However, it comes with strict limits on bandwidth, active CPU time, and storage size. Once your app scales, you will likely need to upgrade to a paid plan.

### How much does Vercel cost per month?

Vercel's Pro plan costs $20 per developer per month. The total monthly costs will increase if you add more developer seats. Overage fees also apply for edge requests, bandwidth, image optimization, edge config, build minutes, and other features.

results.title: Vercel Pricing: Hobby Plan, Pro and Enterprise | Figment
results.snippet:
Vercel's Hobby plan is free but restricted to personal, non-commercial projects; Pro costs $20/month per seat plus metered usage beyond a $20 monthly credit; Enterprise is custom-quoted. The commercial restriction on Hobby, not the resource limits, decides which plan you need. This guide checks Vercel's own pricing and docs pages for what is included, what is metered and what each plan costs, dated September 2026. Our Netlify vs Vercel comparison covers the same Hobby-plan restriction if you are [...] ## How much does each Vercel plan cost?

| Plan | Per month | Per seat | Included usage credit | Commercial use |
------
| Hobby | $0 | Not applicable | Fixed included usage, no overage bill | Not allowed |
| Pro | $20 | $20 per additional Owner or Member seat | $20 per month, does not roll over | Allowed |
| Enterprise | Custom quote | Custom quote | Custom quote | Allowed |

(Source: Vercel Pricing and Vercel Docs, "Vercel Pro Plan".)

## What does the Vercel Hobby plan actually include? [...] Pro's platform fee is $20/month, and that fee buys you one deploying seat plus $20 in monthly usage credit you can spend across billable resources. It is not a separate allowance on top of the fee. Vercel's own docs: "Every Pro plan has $20 in monthly credit," and "The platform fee is a fixed monthly fee that includes $20 in usage credit" (Vercel Docs, "Vercel Pro Plan"). Additional seats with Owner or Member roles cost $20/month each; Viewer seats, which are read-only, are free and unlimited.
